filed.one_line: Nokia and NVIDIA are integrating NVIDIA AI Enterprise software and Nemotron models and libraries into Nokia’s agentic platform for telco-specific agents across radio, core, transport and cloud networks.

filed.quote: Several telecommunication providers, including etisalat UAE, MEO and Airtel, are working with Nokia to identify advanced use cases and integration timelines.
filed.one_line: Etisalat UAE, MEO and Airtel are working with Nokia to identify use cases and integration timelines for its agentic AI platform.

filed.quote: Dell Technologies, Quanta Cloud Technology and Supermicro are supporting flexible NVIDIA Aerial RAN Computer configurations for distributed and centralized deployments that run Nokia 5G anyRAN software alongside AI inference workloads.
filed.one_line: Dell Technologies, Quanta Cloud Technology and Supermicro are supporting NVIDIA Aerial RAN Computer configurations for distributed and centralized deployments running Nokia 5G anyRAN software and AI inference workloads.

filed.quote: Red Hat is bringing AI-RAN technologies onto a common cloud-native platform with Red Hat OpenShift, creating a secure foundation for RAN functions and AI workloads on shared infrastructure.
filed.one_line: Red Hat is bringing AI-RAN technologies onto Red Hat OpenShift for RAN functions and AI workloads on shared infrastructure.
